_comment: Edit this file to add commuters. Station names are looked up automatically via Trafiklab; put an explicit id in station_ids if the lookup picks the wrong stop.

train_filter._note: All trains (Öresundståg and Pågatåg) are kept; both are covered by Skånetrafiken's delay compensation.

compensation_rules._source: Skånetrafiken/Öresundståg terms + Lag (2015:953): 50% at 20-39 min, 75% at 40-59 min, 100% at 60+ min delay at final destination

ticket._note: Value of one trip = price_sek / trips_factor. For a single ticket set type 'single' and trip_price_sek instead. VERIFY the factor Skånetrafiken uses for period tickets.
